up: Retrieve activity rows for target CHEMBL1942 (Alpha-2B adrenergic receptor). Return the first 1000 rows. Required output columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Filters: standard_type must be 'IC50', standard_relation must be '=', pChEMBL value must not be null. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_info AS (SELECT tid, target_type, tax_id FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1942') SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, ti.target_type, ti.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value FROM target_info ti JOIN assays ON assays.tid = ti.tid JOIN activities ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON activities.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
